purpose: Account and portfolio data-quality flags derived from existing local TX identity, GA4 and research assets. Flags describe an evidence limitation or plausibility condition; they are not account diagnoses, plays or customer tasks.

rendering_rules.model_conflict: Read account_spine_research_staging.accounts[company_id].quality_flags dynamically; never hard-code the affected-account list.
rendering_rules.exact_identity_only: SFDC opportunities/features and K2K customer relationships render as account facts only when the crosswalk/match state is exact.
rendering_rules.ga4: Session metrics render for EXACT_SFDC_WEBSITE only. Parent traffic renders once at parent scope. Fuzzy/shared records render an attribution state, not account CVR.
